correctness.rationale: An exact Cayley-square conjugacy gives \(y\mapsto ty+1/2+1/(16ty)\). Every neutral finite composition has \(G(y)=y+B+C/y+O(y^{-2})\), with both coefficients given by reciprocal-prefix sums. Positive increments yield \(Y_n\ge Y_0+nB\), so every eligible trajectory enters the asymptotic regime. The difference of \(Y_n-Bn-(C/B)\log n\) has absolutely summable \(O((\log n)/n^2)\) increments, proving the finite limiting constant and stated remainder. An adjacent swap changes exactly one prefix product, proving the unique sorting extremizers. Exact-rational checks corroborate but do not replace the infinite proof.
